sourceNote: Quoted household mortgage-rate benchmarks from the Bank of England Database. These are market reference rates, not personalised mortgage offers. Product fees, eligibility and lender criteria are not included.
bandNote: 75% LTV benchmark is used at or below 75% LTV. Above 75%, the 95% LTV benchmark is used as a conservative planning proxy because the Bank of England publishes a directly comparable five-year quoted series at 75% and 95% LTV.
